== Published English Original Virtual Set 3 wording ==
The original chooses one qualifying character to be lost with the Seeker. The separately dated July 2007 revision uses the Undercover spy movement and deployment conditions and adds the all-cards result. The other complete issuer face retains opponent-side deployment and control-phase movement, and directly loses both the weapon and qualifying character. Its capture date is proof of existence by that day. The source does not establish an earlier effective date or a sequence relative to the July change.
